title: דנה פ (Dana F)
content: On July 10, 2023, I was on my way to work by riding my scooter. After about ten minutes of riding, a long traffic jam formed. This caused me to move to the right shoulder to continue my journey. I rode on the shoulder at a speed of about 60 km/h for about two minutes until I suddenly heard a boom. In that moment, I realized a car had hit me with great force from my left side. Immediately after the boom, there was nothing visual or tangible. I was in complete darkness. But the sensations were completely present. I felt myself slowly leaving my body. Immediately afterward, I flew at an immense speed horizontally, back and forth. I was nothing; but yet, I was everything. I remember the first thing I said to myself was, "That's it. It's over." Moments later, I felt feelings of joy, elation, and happiness washing over me. I said to myself, "Finally! I'm finally free of it." Meaning that I was free from the body I was trapped in. It's important to mention that I never liked my body and never felt connected to my physical self. After an unknown amount of time and this constant motion, I arrived at a place I cannot describe because everything was completely dark. I did hear a speaking, as a conversation took place there. I was told that it wasn't my time, that there were many things I still needed to do, and I hadn't finished my path in this world. I was then asked if it was all right with me to return and continue my existence in the physical world. I answered "Yes," and immediately afterward, it was as if I was thrown back into my body. Suddenly, I heard a man asking me hysterically and screaming, "What day is it? What day is it?" I couldn't really get my bearings at that moment, but I answered him, "Monday. But give me a moment to get my bearings and don't shout at me. I just woke up." He responded, "Woke up? You were lying there with your eyes open and not answering me!" That was the moment I understood that what I had experienced was completely real. I had passed from this world to another, and returned all at once. During the accident, I broke most of my ribs. I had double fractures on the right and left sides with a punctured lung and air entering my chest cavity. In addition, I broke my shoulder, both knees, and my right thumb. For several days after the accident, I felt disconnected from reality. I could sit quietly for hours, closed off within myself. It was as if I were in a protected space. It was not a place of sadness, pain, or anything else negative. I felt I hadn't completely returned to my body; something in me was still floating and not entirely settled. At the time of the accident, I was in the middle of an academic preparatory program for my bachelor's degree in communication. During the prep program and up until the accident, I felt very scattered. I couldn't really concentrate on studying or be mentally present in classes. A month after the accident, I returned to my studies, and since then everything has changed. I began to discover abilities I never knew I had. I went from being a person who was physically and mentally disorganized to someone much more collected and sharp. Today I am about to begin the third and final year of my degree, and up to this moment I have received the Dean's Award for excellence, was appointed to serve as Chair of the School of Communication, was offered a spot in the President's Excellency Program, and the list goes on. I feel, and based on my knowledge of myself for the 32 years before the incident, that something in this experience completely changed my life. It was as if abilities I never had before were "installed" in me. It was as if I received a significant "version update" in that moment when I was between the physical world and the next.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes, Accident, Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function)
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, This feeling was as if I had no limits. I could know everything, feel everything, and be present everywhere.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning, Absolutely yes. Everything was completely disconnected from the physical world, in any way.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: During the experience, I did not have any vision at all; it was completely dark.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I did not hear anything. Even though I am unaware of whether thoughts were asked of me and whether a conversation took place that was sensory, telepathic, or intuitive.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Uncertain, I am not sure if I heard it or did not hear something during the experience. But I have no way of knowing for certain.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm, Absolutely yes. Everything was completely disconnected from the physical world, in any way.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Happiness, doubt, anxiety, and peace of mind. I felt that my consciousness was finalized, 'and so,' and I returned to my place.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe, That's how it felt.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a definite conscious decision to return to life, As I described it, I was told that my time had not yet come. I was asked if it was okay for me to return and do something with my life, to progress and find myself.
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Jewish, Jewish by belief, but not religious.
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes, My faith in God is much greater. I take upon myself many things like prayers, keeping commandments, lighting Sabbath candles, and more.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, ..... There is nothing to talk about...
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin, I detailed it in the part where I described the experience. I met a being, I don't know who it was.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Uncertain, I was not aware of that.
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Uncertain, It is clear that there was a presence with me, indicating to me in some way that there are meaningful things I need to do. I do not know if this was knowledge or intuition, but since then I feel a sense of mission, repeatedly, very strongly. It seems that my destiny is to fulfill a greater role, to connect, to feel that I am going to be a chosen vessel.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, It is clear to me that whether I returned to the body or whether I am the Messiah for the next, non-physical life.
Yes, I was not aware if this is called information or love. However, there was a feeling of receiving a comforting, superior embrace, a feeling of belonging.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: I have undergone many changes in my connection to all areas of life. Today I do not allow fears to occur at all, the experience changed my life in a way that moves me from end to end. In general, as I remembered before, I feel that there is an ability in me that was not in me before.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes, I manage to give more place to my wife, who sees me a lot more than before I started. You see her without talking and knowing many things from the beginning - as if she is in me with a strong intuition to overcome.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes, The experience was not something that could be described in everyday words.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, I feel that this experience stays with me, it does not leave me for a moment.. As if a place is reserved for it within my consciousness in this world.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes, A feeling as if something else has entered me in between, an ability of another kind. Everything else.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The encounter with Jesus - as if something entered me.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes, I saw the series on Netflix, 'To Survive Death'.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, It feels like a break in reality. Confusing. But not a place of sorrow or depression.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, I have already broken... I am convinced...
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes, On October 7th. When I saw all this death that happened in Israel, somehow in me it was known that all the people there undergo it, somehow it comes out, my belief that everything is fine, it can be good for everyone who needs it. Still waiting.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: I feel that these memories are for a past life. No one is worthy of reaching a place where there is no likeness to it in any one point on the face of the earth. It already does not interest me to see the world, it does not interest me to travel in all kinds of places where I have not been, because there is no likeness to a place where I have already been.
elements.Did the questions asked and information: Uncertain, Yes, there are things that cannot be described in words and can only be left in the space between the stomach and my vision. Many feelings of oneself, many feelings that have no words to describe them, at least not in my language.
